The relationship exceeds generic correspondence boilerplate because several content-bearing components occur in the same order and serve the same functions.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"There is attached a draft of proposed legislation to amend the Internal Revenue Code","parent_excerpt":"I am transmitting herewith a draft of a bill to extend the coverage of the Fair Labor Standards Act","explanation":"Both open by transmitting specifically described draft legislation amending an existing statutory regime."},{"child_excerpt":"This measure is one of various desirable steps, mentioned in my Message to the Congress of February 6","parent_excerpt":"It is designed to carry out a recommendation contained in my message on February 2 to the Congress.","explanation":"Both expressly link the transmitted bill to a recommendation in a recent presidential message to Congress."},{"child_excerpt":"A memorandum prepared by the Secretary of the Treasury explaining the bill in greater detail is also attached.","parent_excerpt":"I am also enclosing the letter I received from the Secretary of Labor commenting briefly upon the provisions in the draft bill.","explanation":"Both close the substantive discussion by identifying an enclosed cabinet-department explanation of the proposed legislation."}]}
